scope: Current-content derived freeze of saved predictions, masks and complete-reference outcomes. It does not establish original measurement provenance or an earlier historical identity.

fields.truth_h30: Unique complete-reference H30 used only to evaluate finite-record slopes
fields.d2_point_h30: Saved D2 point on a masked year; missing on fully observed reference years
fields.point_h30: The point used in the experiment: D2 on masked years, observed reference on unmasked years
fields.missing: Year belongs to the original whole-archive mask design
fields.warm_keep: Complete reference years plus masked years meeting the stored warm-season 90% criterion
fields.original_all_evaluable: Original saved all-year availability flag (at least five retained years and supported points)
fields.original_warm_evaluable: Original saved warm-season availability flag; the thirteen exclusions retain only three or four years

limits: Annual numeric replay only; original daily preprocessing, fitting, daily gap overlap and group uncertainty are not rerun by this entry point.
